plain: The Temple of Sais in ancient Egypt was, according to the researcher Matthew LaCroix, a place built to keep the records of history, and it was later destroyed and gone within some five hundred to a thousand years. LaCroix draws on the account by the ancient Greek writer Plutarch, in which a figure named Sonchis appears. He raises it on Michels' show because, if true, a store of very old knowledge would have been lost with it.
